input.summary: Implemented a Task Management API in TypeScript using Node.js built-in modules with in-memory stores and an event bus. Components: event-bus.ts, services (user, project, task, comment, notification) each in separate files, router.ts for HTTP handling, main.ts for server startup, and demo.ts to exercise features. Implemented pub/sub EventBus and wiring to publish task.assigned, task.statusChanged, and comment.added events. NotificationService subscribes to events and creates notifications. Added minimal shims (src/shims.d.ts) to compile without @types/node. Provided tsconfig.json. Verified successful compilation with TypeScript and ran demo script, showing end-to-end flow working. System is runnable with `npx tsx src/main.ts` and demo via `npx tsx src/demo.ts`.
